# The eBilling Company

> The eBilling Company builds a modern enterprise legal management (ELM) and
> legal e-billing platform for in-house legal departments, with a free
> collaboration portal for outside counsel. Product name: The eBilling System.

## What the platform does

- Matter management: configurable matter types, custom fields and layouts,
  tasks, key dates with calendar invites, status updates, files, search.
- Invoice review & e-billing: LEDES and PDF intake, line-level review with
  billing-guideline enforcement, adjustments and appeals, approval routing,
  accruals, payments and AP export.
- Outside counsel portal (free for firms): guided invoice submission with
  validation before rejection, budget proposal round-trips, timekeeper and
  rate submissions with approvals, shared files and status updates. Each firm
  sees only its own data — enforced with database row-level security.
- Budgets & accruals: life-of-matter, monthly, quarterly and phase budgets;
  multi-firm allocations; health tracking and threshold alerts.
- Service of process: structured intake for subpoenas, summonses and formal
  legal notices, statutory response-window calculation, one-click matter
  creation with documents and deadlines attached.
- Reports: dozens of out-of-the-box reports, saved and shared views,
  subscriptions, CSV export, and an AI ask-to-report builder.
- Security: PostgreSQL row-level security for tenant/matter/vendor isolation,
  an append-only audit ledger, SSO (SAML/OIDC) with TOTP two-factor,
  least-privilege database access.
- Deployment: multi-tenant cloud, dedicated instance, or on-premises (Helm).
- AI policy: zero-data-retention models, US-hosted inference, per-tenant
  provider control. AI assists review; computed figures are computed.
